description: Pre-indexed code knowledge graph, auto syncs on code changes, for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Cursor, OpenCode, AntiGravity, Kiro, CoPilot, and Hermes Agent — fewer tokens, fewer tool calls, 100% local
summary: CodeGraph builds a local, Rust-powered dependency and call graph over your codebase and exposes it as an MCP server, so agents like Claude Code or Codex get surgical cross-file context instead of burning tokens on repeated file reads and greps. That's exactly the kind of toil-removal I want when I'm running parallel sessions in PenguPool or driving a Codex session from my phone via AgentOn Pocket — the agent stops re-scanning the whole repo and just queries the graph. I also appreciate that it ships as a single self-contained binary with auto-sync on file changes: no Node runtime to babysit, no cloud round-trip, no manual reindex step.
